d:
Akhiyan is the soft, dreamy love song from Jatt & Juliet 2, picturised on Diljit Dosanjh and Neeru Bajwa, whose on-screen pairing made the film one of Punjabi cinema's biggest hits. Amber Vashisht and Priyanka sing it over Jassi Katyal's music, with lyrics by Kumaar.
This 8K remaster brings the original video back in sharper detail than ever, so you can relive every frame of the Diljit and Neeru chemistry.
Song Credits
Song: Akhiyan
Singers: Amber Vashisht & Priyanka
Music: Jassi Katyal
Lyrics: Kumaar
Label: Speed Records
